cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hand It Over
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to give up control of a task, object, or decision you believe is being mishandled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Let me handle the seating plan. You've put the exes together.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
